messages:
leah-sales: BigBank just confirmed workload profile: steady 180 RPS, short spikes ~600 RPS for ~20-45s a few times/day. Need a reserve+burst proposal + cost ballpark by EOD.
omar-solutions: Are spikes chat-turn heavy or long single completions? That affects KV cache and batching.
tim-sre: Customer provided split: ~78% short chat turns (25-60 tokens), ~22% long gen (up to 1.8k tokens). Tail latency is our main SL risk.
neha-runtime: Quick calc: steady ~180 RPS * 40 toks = ~7.2k toks/s. Peak ~600 RPS -> ~24k toks/s. For M-class models: reserve 3	6 GPUs baseline; add 3-5 GPUs for hot burst. Quantized fallbacks reduce GPU need ~30%.
elaine-security: Security checklist items: BigBank requires customer KMS (CMEK), VPC-only control plane, and explicit data deletion within 30 days. I can fill questionnaire if we give exact log retention and flow.
leah-sales: Pricing request: two options. Conservative (lower risk) and cost-first (higher burst reliance). Include ops buffer.
neha-runtime: Draft autoscale snippet:
```yaml
min_replicas: 3
max_replicas: 14
target_rps_per_replica: 60
burst_pool_gpus: 4
quantized_fallback: true
cooldown_seconds: 40
```
Maps to reserve 3 GPUs, hot-burst 4 GPUs, autoscale to 14 replicas.
tim-sre: Ops notes: prewarm KV for known prefixes 30s before predicted spikes. Canary fallback to smaller model at p99>1s. Add synthetic smoke every hour to verify warm pools.
omar-solutions: I'll draft proposal text and include cost sim options. @neha-runtime can you validate per-model p99 numbers by 15:30?
neha-runtime: Yes — running bench matrix now, will post numbers + p99 estimates by 15:20 UTC.
elaine-security: I'll return completed questionnaire items (KMS, VPC, retention) by 16:00 UTC.
leah-sales: Awesome. If we have perf + security answers by 16:00 I can ship the proposal to BigBank today. Thanks team :handshake:
